Kareena Kapoor faces controversy over Bhopal royal heirloom pendant

Actress Kareena Kapoor Khan has received a legal notice for wearing a pendant featuring the 'Ayat-ul-Kursi', a verse from the Quran, which is reportedly a royal heirloom of the Bhopal family. The controversy arose over her choice of jewelry during Diwali celebrations.
